name: Butalbital
aliases: 5-allyl-5-isobutylbarbituric acid, 5-Allyl-5-isobutylbarbituric acid, 5-isobutyl-5-allylbarbituric acid, alisobumal, allylbarbital, allylbarbitone, allylbarbituric acid, Allylbarbituric acid
summary: Butalbital is a barbiturate with an intermediate duration of action. Butalbital is often combined with other medications, such as paracetamol (acetaminophen) (as butalbital/acetaminophen) or aspirin, for the treatment of pain and headache. The various formulations combined with codeine are FDA-approved for the treatment of tension headaches.

uses.text: Butalbital is often combined with other medications, such as paracetamol (acetaminophen) (as butalbital/acetaminophen) or aspirin, for the treatment of pain and headache. The various formulations combined with codeine are FDA-approved for the treatment of tension headaches.

sideEffects.text: Side effects for butalbital are usually well tolerated.

summaryZh: 布他比妥（英語：Butalbital）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C11H16N2O3，屬於巴比妥類藥物，與他布比妥是同分異構體，區別在於異丁基變為仲丁基。
summaryZhHans: 布他比妥（英语：Butalbital）是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C11H16N2O3，属于巴比妥类药物，与他布比妥是同分异构体，区别在于异丁基变为仲丁基。

pharmacology.en: Like other barbiturates, it binds the GABA-A receptor and holds its chloride channel open for longer. This damps brain activity, causing sedation and easing tension-type headache.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他巴比妥類一樣，它與 GABA-A 受體結合並使其氯離子通道開啟更久，從而抑制腦部活動，造成鎮靜並緩解緊縮型頭痛。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他巴比妥类一样，它与 GABA-A 受体结合并使其氯离子信道打开更久，从而抑制脑部活动，造成镇静并缓解紧缩型头痛。

fact.en: It is almost always sold mixed with paracetamol or aspirin and caffeine for headache. In several countries those combinations are being withdrawn because of the dependence that comes with frequent use.
fact.zh: 布他比妥幾乎總是與乙醯胺酚或阿斯匹靈及咖啡因混合，用於治療頭痛。數個國家正逐步將這些複方下市，因為頻繁使用會造成依賴。
fact.zhHans: 布他比妥几乎总是与乙酰胺酚或阿斯匹灵及咖啡因混合，用于治疗头痛。数个国家正逐步将这些复方下市，因为频繁使用会造成依赖。
